              COUNTY COUNCIL OF BALTIMORE COUNTY, MARYLAND
                   Legislative Session 2025, Legislative Day No. 13

                                        Bill No. 55-25


                                  Mr. Mike Ertel, Chairman


                            By the County Council, August 4, 2025


                                          A BILL
                                         ENTITLED


AN ACT concerning

       Revision of Councilmanic Districts



FOR    the purpose of revising and reconstituting the councilmanic districts of Baltimore County

       in accordance with the increase from seven to nine Council districts, beginning with the

       2026 election, as required by Sections 206 and 207 of the Baltimore County Charter.



       WHEREAS, Bill 47-24 amended Section 206 of the Baltimore County Charter (the

“Charter”) to increase the number of Council districts and Council members from seven to nine,

beginning with the 2026 election; and

       WHEREAS, upon the passage of Bill 47-24, a question was placed on the 2024 ballot and

subsequently approved by a majority of Baltimore County voters; and



EXPLANATION:          CAPITALS INDICATE MATTER ADDED TO EXISTING LAW.
                      [Brackets] indicate matter stricken from existing law.
                      Strike out indicates matter stricken from bill.
                      Underlining indicates amendments to bill.
             WHEREAS, upon the ratification of the 2024 ballot question, the County Council

     established the 2025 Baltimore County Councilmanic Redistricting Commission (the

     “Commission”) in accordance with Charter Section 207; and

             WHEREAS, on June 17, 2025, the Commission submitted its Final Report and

     Recommendation to the County Council, which included a recommended map; and

             WHEREAS,         upon    the   submission        of   the   Commission’s   Final   Report   and

     Recommendation, Charter Section 207 empowers and directs the County Council to revise the

     councilmanic districts; and

             WHEREAS, this legislation revises and reconstitutes the councilmanic districts into nine

     districts; now therefore



 1           SECTION 1. BE IT ENACTED BY THE COUNTY COUNCIL OF BALTIMORE

 2   COUNTY, MARYLAND that, in accordance with Section 207 of the Baltimore County Charter,

 3   the councilmanic districts of Baltimore County be and are hereby revised and reconstituted to

 4   read as follows:

 5

14   for the next regularly scheduled election of the County Council in 2026.
